newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin Express says has 85 pct seat occupancy rate.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Express says has 85 pct seat occupancy rate.

text.p: British entrepreneur Richard Branson said on Tuesday his new Virgin Express cut-price airline had an 85-percent seat occupancy rate due to its fares which underprice normal ticket prices by up to 75 percent.

"If we charged the full fare on Virgin Express, only 33 percent of our seats would be full. As it is, we are selling 85 percent and we're making profits," Branson told a news conference in Brussels to officially launch the new Brussels-Copenhagen link.
Branson shrugged off fears by travel agents that they would lose income because of the lower fares.
"The end result is that they'll make more money because there'll be more people up in the air, and that will compensate for the lower air tickets," he said.
